at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError` from `ledgerly.errors` with a snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity`, `negative_amount` or `invalid_amount`, and pass the offending value as the message.

at-0009.title: Record audit entry for every balance change
at-0009.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must call ledgerly.audit.record("<past_tense_event>", <entity>_id=..., amount=...) with payment_id=... or invoice_id=...; finance reconciles the ledger from these entries.

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must write an audit entry with ledgerly.audit.record("<past_tense_event>", <entity>_id=..., amount=...), where <entity> is the payment or invoice the money moves against (payment_id=... or invoice_id=...). Finance reconciles the ledger from these entries.
